projects.title: إسلامي · Islami
projects.subtitle: Free Islamic App — Works 100% Offline
projects.description: A free Islamic companion app that works with no internet at all: the complete 604-page Quran with offline commentary, accurate prayer times, Adhkar, and reading plans — installable on web, iOS, Android, and desktop.
highlights: The full 604-page Uthmani Mushaf with Tafsir Al-Muyassar — readable with no internet
Accurate prayer times, Adhkar, Tasbih, and Khatmah reading plans
Zero ads, zero tracking — installs like a native app on web, iOS, Android, and desktop

caseStudy.problem: Daily Islamic tools — Quran with commentary, prayer times, Adhkar, reading plans — must work instantly with zero internet, and web apps usually die the moment the connection drops.
caseStudy.approach: Built a zero-dependency offline-first app: a Service Worker caches everything, the device stores the full Tafsir locally, and the whole thing installs like a native app while staying pure vanilla JavaScript.
architecture: Zero-dependency modular vanilla JavaScript — no frameworks, no trackers, no ads
Service Worker precache + on-device storage for the complete offline Tafsir Al-Muyassar
Tap any verse to read its offline commentary in place
Installs as a native app across web, iOS, Android, and desktop

projects.title: asus-control-macos
projects.subtitle: Fan, Thermal & Power Control for macOS on ASUS Laptops
projects.description: Full fan, thermal, and power control for ASUS TUF & ROG laptops running macOS — custom fan curves, switchable power modes, and live temperature readings, all from a native menu bar app.
highlights: Custom fan curves and power modes that macOS never provides on ASUS hardware
Live temperature and fan-speed telemetry read straight from the machine's sensors
Reacts to hardware changes instantly — no background polling, no battery drain

caseStudy.problem: ASUS laptop owners running macOS get no vendor support: macOS can't see the fans, can't switch power modes, and the hardware runs hot and loud with no way to control it.
caseStudy.approach: Built a native macOS control suite: a kernel extension for safe hardware access, an event-driven daemon that responds to sensor changes the moment they happen, and a clean menu bar app for fan curves and power modes.
architecture: macOS kernel extension (C++ / IOKit) with strict safety boundaries for hardware access
Event-driven control daemon — responds to sensor events instead of polling on a timer
Native Swift menu bar app with custom fan curves and live thermal telemetry
Per-model capability profiles covering supported ASUS TUF & ROG laptops

projects.title: BOSSMAX
projects.subtitle: Cross-Platform Video Export Optimizer for Short-Form Platforms
projects.description: Cross-platform Flutter mobile application for preparing high-clarity social video exports with platform-tuned presets for TikTok and Instagram Reels, one-tap workflows, a bilingual Arabic/English interface, and offline execution.
highlights: Platform-calibrated export presets for TikTok and Instagram Reels delivery targets
One-tap export pipeline selecting target output parameters automatically
Full offline operation with a bilingual Arabic/English interface

caseStudy.problem: Short-form video platforms aggressively re-encode uploads, degrading sharpness and 60fps motion smoothness unless exports are calibrated to each platform's delivery targets.
caseStudy.approach: Built a cross-platform Flutter application with per-platform export presets, streamlined one-tap local processing, a bilingual Arabic/English Liquid Glass interface, and self-contained offline license verification.
architecture: Flutter + Dart cross-platform UI with Liquid Glass navigation and bilingual AR/EN localization
Per-platform export presets tuned to TikTok and Instagram Reels compression limits
One-tap local export workflow engineered for consistent visual clarity
Offline license verification with zero runtime network dependency

projects.title: universal-harness
projects.subtitle: Portable AI CLI Runtime & Encrypted Android LAN Bridge
projects.description: Portable TypeScript/Node.js runtime for running AI coding CLIs from a USB drive or desktop host without local installation, paired with an encrypted local-network bridge to an Android companion.
highlights: Runs AI coding CLIs such as Claude Code and Gemini CLI from a USB drive with zero host installation
Dual-mode Kotlin Android companion: encrypted remote controller or standalone on-device runtime
End-to-end encrypted local-network transport between desktop hosts and mobile devices

caseStudy.problem: AI coding CLIs and their configurations are typically tied to a single host machine, requiring repeated setup across laptops and leaving no portable remote workflow.
caseStudy.approach: Built a self-contained portable runtime for USB drives and desktops behind a unified CLI adapter interface, paired with a Kotlin Android app serving as both an encrypted remote controller and a standalone on-device server.
architecture: Single portable TypeScript / Node.js runtime — zero-install execution on USB or desktop
Unified CLI adapter layer for integrating AI coding tools without duplicating core logic
Encrypted local-network transport between desktop hosts and mobile endpoints
Kotlin Android app: secure remote controller and standalone on-device server
